Winnie the Pooh

Adapted from A. A. Milne's "Winnie the Pooh"

One Act youth theater production featuring actors ages 6 to 10.

Directed by Parker Miller

Based on the beloved stories by A. A. Milne, Winnie the Pooh follows the charming adventures of Pooh and his friends in the Hundred Acre Wood. Alongside Christopher Robin, Rabbit, Piglet, Owl, Eeyore, Kanga, and Roo, Pooh sets out on a series of delightful escapades — from tracking mysterious Woozles and attempting to trap the elusive Heffalumps to searching for Eeyore’s missing tail and braving a blustery day to rescue Piglet. Join us for a sweet, honey-filled adventure that reminds us all of the joy found in simple moments and loyal friends.

Showtimes

November 20 and 21 at 7:30 PM
November 21 and 22 at 2:30 PM
